observation: Long roofed garden spans the rear of a dry dense pale-block board.
Blue foreground pool joins a high winding channel below the roofed garden.
Violet left arch and blue rear arch frame green ring blocks and dry pools.
Blue and violet side basins are separated by the broad upper white route.
Three roofed planted towers rise over dry pale channels and front basins.
Blue side pool and cyan right route remain visible around the tall roofs.
Central green rings and dry front pools sit below the stepped rear source.
Blue foreground and upper side basins connect around the tan center blocks.
Amber source stream drops from the left of the roofed central courtyard.
Amber right basin and blue foreground basin retain clearly distinct water colors.
Low planted roofs and dry blue-ring basins occupy the diagonal board.
Blue left and front basins connect below the winding white elevated channel.
Bright rear blue source overlaps stacked pale pipes above dry roofed gardens.
Blue side pools and the front fountain route remain visible around the tan tower.
Three green rings lie on the broad central tan roof below a rear source.
Blue rear and right pools connect around the roof while all green rings remain visible.
Tall planted roofed column rises above dry front ring basins and pale pipes.
Blue foreground basin and raised left and right pools are clearly separated.
Violet source path and dry planted courts surround a central pale tower.
Violet basins wrap around the tall stone route with the roofed corners intact.
Blue source descends through tan columns into a dense dry white pipe stack.
Raised blue pool and pale loop remain visible beneath the tan roof.
Dry side garden beds and stacked pipes surround the large tan center roof.
Blue upper and front-right basins connect around the preserved central roof.
